description: This file defines the HomePageService class in the OrangeHRM authorization service module. The class provides methods to retrieve default paths for various modules and the homepage based on user roles, utilizing traits for user role management.

classes.name: HomePageService
classes.description: Service class that provides methods related to user homepage and module default paths based on user roles.

methods.name: getHomePagePath
methods.description: Retrieves the homepage path for the current user role.

methods.name: getTimeModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Retrieves the default path for the 'time' module.

methods.name: getLeaveModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Retrieves the default path for the 'leave' module.

methods.name: getAdminModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Retrieves the default path for the 'admin' module.

methods.name: getPimModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Retrieves the default path for the 'pim' module.

methods.name: getRecruitmentModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Retrieves the default path for the 'recruitment' module.

methods.name: getPerformanceModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Retrieves the default path for the 'performance' module.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Retrieves the default page for a given module name.
